data.name: Hidden Agendas
data.description: A snoop learns to obscure his thoughts and endeavors from prying eyes and even intrusive magic. When a snoop uses inspiration while attempting a Bluff check to pass secret messages or attempting a Linguistics check to create forgeries, he can roll his inspiration dice twice and take the higher result. In addition, the snoop can use inspiration when attempting a saving throw against a divination spell or effect without expending a use of inspiration.
